summary: The change replaces the audit record on LedgerService.amend_memo with an application log that carries only payment_id. Amending a memo still writes payment state, so AUD-1 requires an audit event with actor, action, target, and time, and that event is gone. No qualifying exception excuses the deviation. Ticket, independent approval, CI on the head commit, and the other process checks are in order, and the new log line does not contain NPI, but the missing audit event is enough to reject the change.
